segments.he: וְכׇל מַעֲשֵׂה בֵּית דִּין הֲרֵי זֶה יַחְזִיר. הָהוּא גִּיטָּא דְּאִשְׁתְּכַח בֵּי דִינָא דְּרַב הוּנָא, דַּהֲוָה כְּתִיב בֵּיהּ ״בִּשְׁוִירֵי מָתָא דְּעַל רָכִיס נַהֲרָא״. אֲמַר רַב הוּנָא:
segments.en: § The Gemara addresses that which the mishna states: «And» with regard to «any court enactment,» the one who found it «must return» it to its presumed owner. The Gemara relates: There was «a certain bill of divorce that was found» in «the court of Rav Huna, in which it was written» that the bill of divorce was written «in Sheviri City, which is» located «on the Rakhis River. Rav Huna said» about this:
